review_candidates.title: Senior IT Service Specialist
review_candidates.description: GROUP Founded in 1895, Jebsen is a privately-held marketing, distribution and investment organisation established in Greater China. It partners with leading brand companies to bring a wide array of quality products to Greater China while driving success for its people and business partners, protecting the environment and serving the communities in which it operates. Purpose of the Job The Senior IT Service Specialist is a crucial frontline role responsible for providing high-quality technical assistance within a fast-paced investment environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing unparalleled, real-time technology support to traders, portfolio managers, and senior management. This role demands an individual with exceptional technical acumen, maintaining composure under pressure, and a deep understanding of the front-office ecosystem. Responsibilities Serve as the primary technology point of contact for the trading and investment desks, providing timely and expert-level support for incidents and service requests that impact business operations. Provide comprehensive support for investment and front-office tools, including Bloomberg Terminal, Enfusion investment management platform, FactSet, and related market data services. Provide technical support during trading hours and respond with urgency to issues affecting traders, portfolio managers, and senior management. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across desktop, applications, Microsoft 365, advanced Excel usage, network connectivity, video conferencing, and market data infrastructure. Manage the incident and request lifecycle using the IT Service Management (ITSM) tool, ensuring tickets are properly logged, updated, documented, and resolved within agreed SLAs. Maintain accurate IT asset records for user devices and coordinate replacement, repair, return, and disposal activities as required. Support IT procurement activities for users, including gathering requirements, preparing purchase requests, coordinating quotations, tracking order status, and following up with vendors, procurement, and finance teams. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for system upgrades, maintenance, repairs, and issue resolution. Participate in IT projects, including system upgrades, office moves, new technology rollouts, and service improvement initiatives. Monitor system health, perform routine checks, and ensure compliance with company IT policies and security standards. Support the adoption of AI-enabled IT service tools, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, chatbot/self-service support, and knowledge base automation, to improve user experience and reduce repetitive support requests. Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to streamline ticket handling, reporting, user guidance, and operational workflows while following company IT security and data protection policies. Provide guidance and training to users on IT best practices, policies, systems, and software usage. Provide remote IT support for Europe users when required, including occasional non-office-hours support for critical business activities, major incidents, planned changes, or urgent user needs. Perform ad-hoc duties as assigned. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or High Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred. Minimum of 6-8 years’ experience in IT support, including at least 3 years within the financial services industry, a fund house, or a trading environment. More senior candidates are also welcome to apply. Hands-on experience supporting Bloomberg Terminal, Enfusion investment management platform, and FactSet is a must. Solid understanding of core IT infrastructure, including Active Directory, TCP/IP networking, DNS, and DHCP. Proven experience supporting Microsoft 365 in a corporate domain environment. Familiarity with mobile device management solutions, such as Microsoft Intune. Familiarity with AI-enabled workplace tools, such as Claude Cowork, Microsoft 365 Copilot, IT support chatbots, self-service knowledge platforms, or workflow automation tools, is preferred. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure. Strong customer service mindset and excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and respond quickly in a fast-paced, global business environment. Awareness of responsible AI usage, data privacy, and information security principles when using AI tools in a corporate environment. Willingness to occasionally work outside standard office hours to support Europe users or urgent business needs. Good command of written and spoken English is a must. Relevant IT certifications are a plus, such as ITIL, Microsoft Certified Professional, or CCNA. SUCCESS BREEDS SUCCESS. With over 100 years of history, Jebsen’s success has been made possible through our commitment to our partners, to our communities, and to our most valuable asset — our people. We offer dedicated and talented individuals the opportunity to engage with a family of premium global brands. Employees who pursue excellence are given a diverse platform that provides continuous development and career exposure. At Jebsen, success breeds success.

review_candidates.title: Senior GCP Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: This is us At Avenga, we believe that human creativity empowers technology that matters. Operating globally, our 6000+ specialists provide a full spectrum of services, including business and tech advisory, enterprise solutions, CX, UX and Ul design, managed services, product development, and software development. This is the job As a Senior GCP Infrastructure Engineer, you will contribute to enterprise application migration projects as part of a large-scale cloud transformation programme. You will work on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure for enterprise workloads, with a focus on reliability, security, and automation. Your work will include Landing Zone Architecture, networking, IAM, security, monitoring, and infrastructure automation with Terraform. Working closely with application, platform, and security teams, you will support the migration of enterprise workloads to GCP and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure or deployment issues as they arise. This is you You bring hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure and enjoy working in environments where automation, security, reliability, and clear troubleshooting matter. You have experience with: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and the design, setup, and support of cloud infrastructure for enterprise environments Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and manage cloud resources through Infrastructure as Code Kubernetes, ideally Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and/or Docker for container-based environments Cloud networking, including VPC, VPN, Firewalls, and Load Balancers IAM and security, including access management and secure configuration of cloud environments Linux systems and command-line work in infrastructure or DevOps environments Git and collaborative development workflows CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Cloud Build to support automated delivery processes Monitoring and logging to ensure reliable and observable cloud environments Troubleshooting cloud infrastructure and deployment issues in a structured and solution-oriented way Advanced English for effective communication in an international environment This is your role As part of the project, you will: Design, build, and support GCP infrastructure for application migration projects Configure Landing Zone components, including networking, IAM, security, and monitoring Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform Support the migration of enterprise workloads to GCP Collaborate with application, platform, and security teams Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and deployment issues What awaits you at Avenga? Through our values, Better Minds, Bolder Ideas, and Bigger Hearts, we strive to provide you with the tools, autonomy, trust, and assistance you need to excel. Enjoy benefits like private health insurance, well-being programs, flexible and hybrid work models, laptops and gear, training, language classes, social events, great offices, and more. At Avenga, everyone matters. We provide equal opportunities in recruitment, career development, and leadership, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to fostering a work environment where our diverse community of employees, candidates, and business partners actively shapes our growth. By bringing together people from different backgrounds and experiences, we build a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves while honoring the boundaries of others.

review_candidates.description: About Bodycote At Bodycote, we’re more than the world’s leading provider of heat treatment and specialist thermal processing services. We’re a people business at heart. Our commitment to innovation and sustainability shapes everything we do. With a global footprint and a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. Sustainability is central to our future. We’re on an ambitious journey to reduce our environmental impact through advanced technologies, smarter processes, and ongoing innovation, with our teams around the world playing a key role in making that happen. The Role As IT Service Support Analyst , you’ll be the primary point of contact for IT incidents, service requests, and technical enquiries, delivering a high-quality, customer-focused support experience. You’ll take ownership of the triage, prioritisation, diagnosis, and resolution of hardware, software, network, and application issues through a blended first and second line support model, generally provided remotely, delivering meaningful outcomes for our business, our customers, and the industries we serve. This role is within our IT Service Delivery organisation and is responsible for ensuring incidents and service requests are managed efficiently in line with agreed service levels, while maintaining clear communication, ownership, and a strong customer focus throughout the lifecycle. This role is focused on customer experience across our regional locations , delivering incident management, technical support, operational stability, and continual improvement. The role builds and maintains strong relationships with customers, colleagues, and external partners , recognising that trust, communication, and collaboration are essential to understanding needs, resolving issues effectively, and delivering a high-quality service experience. Who We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who brings: Windows operating systems, server and client operating systems. Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, Active Directory, Exchange, NTFS and File Sharing permissions. Device imaging, builds, provisioning, configuring, deploying, and supporting end-user devices, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals. Software deployment, patch management, and endpoint lifecycles. Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, operating system, application, and device performance issues. Networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and remote access technologies. Experience supporting endpoint security and device management solutions, including AV, EDR, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike Falcon, Intune (or equivalent), alongside a sound understanding of IT security principles, access management, MFA, and data protection. Familiarity with platforms such as HaloITSM / ServiceNow or equivalent tools. Working experience, along with a strong understanding of ITIL Incident, Request, Problem, Knowledge, Change and Major Incident Management processes. Experience in meeting SLA and KPI performance standards. Qualifications IT or technical education, including English and Maths, or equivalent relevant experience in an IT support environment Microsoft, CompTIA (A+, Network+), or other relevant technical certifications Qualifications or training in endpoint management, device provisioning, or modern workplace technologies (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft 365) Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a customer facing role supporting a Windows based environment ITIL Foundation certification Degree, Diploma, BTEC, or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline Fluent Czech and English - Additional European language skill is welcome Basic PowerShell scripts/automation What’s In It For You Career progression opportunities within a global organisation Exposure to international projects and change initiatives A supportive, inclusive culture where your development matters The opportunity to help shape the next chapter of our business Competitive salary and benefits package Location & Work Pattern This role is based in Prague with hybrid regime. Some travel may be required depending on business needs. Ready to Apply? If you’re ready to join Bodycote and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and start your journey with us. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of characteristics protected by local law, including (where applicable) gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, and ethnic origin. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

review_candidates.description: ispace is seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior GNC Systems Engineer to join the System Design Group under the Global Design division, responsible for the design and development of lunar landers and other transportation and/or communication/navigation platforms. The ideal candidate will have in-depth experience on GNC (AOCS) design, implementation, integration, V&V and operations, good technical knowledge of multiple spacecraft subsystems and experience in the system engineering disciplines for spacecraft design. review_candidates.description: Imagine a future where everyone has instant, low-cost access to intelligence. We’re building a fully featured European AI cloud - with everything one needs to train, experiment with, and deploy AI models. In addition, our GPUs run on 100% renewable energy . We’re ambitious, curious, and gutsy doers. We practice a low hierarchy across the company and high morale in our teams. We’ve already achieved a lot, yet we’re only getting started. Now it’s your chance to join the ride. We offer more than just the job - we offer a career-defining opportunity to be part of building something big! Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished. Why Verda Cash + equity compensation along with various fringe benefits (e.g., healthcare, lunch, wellbeing, etc.). Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth. 31 nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. An opportunity with make a clear impact and work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. Practicalities Work mode: Remote (Germany) Travel: Frequent travel on sites Employment type: Full-time and permanent. About The Role Verda is expanding its physical infrastructure footprint and we are bringing new data centre capacity online through colocation facilities, third-party partnerships, and strategic agreements across Germany. Every new site we open starts with someone finding it, qualifying it, contracting it, and getting it ready to receive hardware. That person is you. We are looking for a Data Centre Expansion Manager (Germany) to own the end-to-end process of identifying and delivering new colocation and data centre capacity within the German market. This is a focused, commercially and technically intensive role. You will spend significant time reviewing inbound site proposals and opportunities, conducting due diligence on colocation providers, and driving procurement processes to close. What You Will Do Lead and oversee the identification, evaluation, and development of data centre and infrastructure expansion opportunities in Germany. Review incoming site proposals and colocation opportunities assessing power infrastructure, cooling systems, fibre connectivity, redundancy architecture, rack density, and physical security. Negotiate, structure, and manage commercial agreements, colocation leases, partnerships, and vendor contracts on behalf of the Company. Represent the Company in dealings with local authorities, regulatory bodies, utilities, and third-party stakeholders as required. Own the tendering and procurement process for new German capacity: RFI/RFP preparation, vendor shortlisting, commercial negotiation, and contract execution. Manage project budgets, financial models, and investment cases related to German expansion activities. Ensure all expansion activities comply with applicable German laws, regulations, and Company policies. Coordinate internal and external workstreams (Construction, DC Operations, Hardware, Procurement, Legal) to deliver expansion projects on time and within budget. Provide regular reporting to senior management on project status, risks, and material developments. Build and maintain a live pipeline of evaluated and pre-qualified German sites so Verda is never reacting to capacity needs reactively. Support the establishment and ongoing governance of the Company's operational presence in Germany. What We Are Looking For 5+ years in data centre capacity acquisition, colocation procurement, or infrastructure real estate with hands-on German market experience. Strong technical foundation: ability to assess a facility's power and cooling infrastructure, identify gaps, and know what questions to ask when something does not add up. Direct experience reviewing and evaluating inbound colocation proposals and shortlisting processes. Proven track record running RFI/RFP processes, commercial evaluation, and supplier negotiation. Comfortable reviewing and negotiating colocation and power contracts without needing Legal to explain every clause. Willingness and ability to travel frequently to sites across Germany. Strong Plus Experience evaluating high-density GPU or HPC facilities — understanding of 140kW+ per rack power requirements, liquid cooling readiness, and InfiniBand-compatible infrastructure. Existing relationships with major German colocation operators and capacity brokers. Familiarity with German power markets — grid connection processes, substation capacity timelines, and renewable energy sourcing. Experience closing multiple simultaneous deals from technical evaluation through to contract execution. What's Next We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now. Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don’t accept applications sent by email.

review_candidates.description: This role at a glance Based in Dubai (UAE). We are not hiring remotely and relocating afterwards, you are already here. Native French speaker, required. Not fluent, native. You will build editorial lines, write hooks and direct people on camera in French all day. English required for the Emirati client base. Arabic is a plus, never a requirement. In-house or freelance, both work. Tell us which you prefer, we build the setup around the profile. Offices in Dubai Design District (d3) , hybrid: office days with the team, remote the rest of the time. 3 years minimum in social media. Agency experience is a plus, not a must. Quick presentation Short Agency is France's #1 vertical video agency. We help brands drive their entire acquisition strategy and produce some of the highest performing ads in the country. You can see our work here: www.shortagency.ae. We are a group of about 30 people, based in Bordeaux, France, and we have already worked with 500+ brands across every sector: e-commerce, apps, SaaS, restaurants, physical retail, info products, agencies, managing ad accounts ranging from €2,000 to €1,000,000 in monthly spend. Short Agency is actually a group made up of several entities, each specialized in one part of the production chain: creative advertising strategy, media buying, video and photo production, and editing. This full in-house setup is what lets us move fast and control quality end to end, from the first creative idea to the final ad running on Meta or TikTok. Short Agency is now expanding into the UAE. This is the same agency you know from France, launching its Emirati branch. The team here is being built from the ground up, and the Social Media Manager we're hiring will be one of the very first people on the ground, working directly with Mathis Faivre (Short Agency Group) and Clément Vannier, General Manager of Short Agency in the UAE. Must-haves You create content yourself, and you still do. Video and visuals. Not a brief writer who hands it over: you shoot, you edit, you post You have created content for brands , not only for your own accounts Vertical is your home turf. TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts. You know the codes, the hooks, the formats, what dies in three seconds and why Organic first. This role is mostly organic content, with enough understanding of paid to know what makes a piece of content work as an ad 3 years minimum in social media. In an agency, in-house at a brand, or as a freelancer with real clients Native French, plus English. Arabic is a plus Based in Dubai The role You own the social media output of the clients assigned to you, from the strategy to the published post. You imagine what the brand should say, you go and film it, you edit it, and you are the person the client talks to. This is a hands-on role. You are not orchestrating a production team from behind a desk: on shoot days you are on site with the client, phone in hand, directing them in front of the camera. 1. Content creation Shoot video content for clients, mostly on iPhone Edit it: cuts, subtitles, sound, pacing Create static and animated visuals: carousels, stories, covers Write hooks, captions and scripts Keep a consistent visual and editorial identity for each brand Produce enough volume to feed a real publishing rhythm Goal: content that gets watched, not content that gets approved. 2. Editorial strategy Build the editorial line for each client: angles, formats, tone, publishing rhythm Turn a business objective into content ideas that actually work on the platforms Build and hold the content calendar Watch what performs, in the client sector and outside it, and bring back what is worth stealing Adapt the same idea to TikTok, Reels and Shorts without publishing the same thing three times Goal: brands that have something to say and a reason to be watched. 3. Shoot days Prepare the shoot: the ideas, the shot list, the props, the location Run the day on site with the client Direct people who are not actors and are uncomfortable on camera Shoot light: phone, natural light, minimal gear Come back with enough material to cover several weeks of publishing These are social shoots, not ad productions. No crew, no heavy setup, no permits to chase. What matters is speed, volume and the ability to make an ordinary business owner look good on camera. 4. Client relationship Be the main point of contact for the clients you handle Run kick offs and understand the business behind the brand Present the strategy and defend the creative choices Manage feedback and difficult conversations yourself Run review calls and keep clients on board over time Goal: clients who trust you enough to let you take risks with their content. 5. Performance Read what worked and what did not, in views, retention and engagement Turn that reading into the next batch of content Understand how an organic piece behaves once it is pushed as an ad Report to clients in plain language, not in vanity metrics Goal: a content machine that gets better every month. 6. What this role demands We're looking for someone who produces. Someone with taste, speed, and the willingness to shoot on a Tuesday afternoon in 40 degrees because that is when the client is available. You need real autonomy, real ideas, and the ability to hold several brands at once without any of them feeling neglected. Short Agency's UAE launch is a fast growing new venture. Being one of the first hires means real upside as the team and the market grow, with a path toward leading the social media output for the whole UAE market. 7. Terms and compensation In-house or freelance, both are possible. Tell us what you are looking for. Offices in Dubai Design District (d3). Hybrid: office days with the team, remote the rest of the time. Based in Dubai , required. Compensation is discussed, not fixed in advance. There is no salary grid and no pay parity across the team: what we offer depends entirely on the profile, the experience and the scope each person takes on. 8. How to apply Applications go through one short form, and that is the only way in. We do not review CVs sent by email or profiles sent by private message: if the form has not been filled in, the application is not considered. It takes about five minutes, plus a two-minute video at the end. We use it to qualify every candidate against the same criteria, so the shortlist is built on what people have actually done rather than on who wrote the nicest message. We get back to everyone.

review_candidates.title: Project Manager Linear Assets
review_candidates.description: Arcadis is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van duurzame ontwerp-, engineering- en adviesoplossingen voor natuurlijke en gebouwde omgevingen. Met meer dan 34.000 medewerkers in ruim 30 landen zetten wij ons in om de levenskwaliteit te verbeteren. Iedereen speelt daarbij een belangrijke rol. Dankzij de kracht van vele nieuwsgierige geesten kunnen we samen de meest complexe uitdagingen ter wereld oplossen en samen meer impact maken. Welke uitdaging ga jij aan? Wij zoeken enthousiaste collega's om ons huidig energietransitie team te versterken bij de uitdagingen en opportuniteiten rond elektrificatie en transport van hernieuwbare energie. Je zal deel uitmaken van een ervaren team van projectmanagers, lead engineers en designers die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het uitwerken van hoogspanningskabel projecten, alsook later in onze groeidomeinen leiding- en warmteprojecten in het kader van energietransitie. Als projectmanager / lead engineer lineaire energie-infrastructuur werk je zelfstandig en efficiënt projecten uit en coördineer je daarbij het projectteam. Concreet betekent dit dat je de behoeften van de klant weet te vertalen in ontwerpen: je geeft input bij offertes, je kan de scope van het project bepalen en richting geven aan de technische oplossing tijdens de ontwerpfase. Je bepaalt de planning, draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor de verschillende onderdelen reikend van tracé over vergunning tot ontwerp. Je rapporteert periodiek over de gerealiseerde mijlpalen en de fundamentele problemen, je onderhoudt contacten met de opdrachtgever en je stuurt intern het projectteam aan. Je zorgt ervoor dat het project gerealiseerd wordt binnen het budget en de vooropgestelde timing en bent verantwoordelijkheid voor de deliverables, kwaliteit, het financiële aspect, rapportering en technische communicatie. Type projecten bij Arcadis waaraan je kan meewerken : “Hoogspanningsverbinding ALEGrO” "Antwerpen ontwikkelt warmtenet op grote schaal." Wat heb jij in je mars? Als projectmanager ben je vertrouwd met het werken binnen lump sum-projecten en het beheren van scope variations, en beschik je over een grondige kennis en ervaring in de opvolging van financiële KPI’s Je beschikt over sterke people skills om het huidige projectteam naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je bent ingenieur met minstens 7 jaar ervaring als projectmanager alsook lead engineer binnen ondergrondse infrastructuurprojecten. Je beschikt over een grondige kennis van ondergrondse infrastructuur (KLIP/KLIM, sleuven en gestuurde boringen) en bent gemotiveerd om deze expertise in te zetten voor de ontwikkeling van duurzame energie-infrastructuur in gans België. Je bent vertrouwd met vergunningen in België (omgevingsvergunningen in Vlaanderen en permis d’urbanisme / environnement in Wallonië) en weet hoe je deze procedures efficiënt toepast binnen infrastructuurprojecten. Je draagt kwaliteit en veiligheid hoog in het vaandel, kan vlot motiveren, delegeren en bijsturen. Dankzij je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden leg je vlot contact met zowel de klanten (de transmissienetbeheerders of industriële klanten) als de interne medewerkers (topografen, design- en engineeringsteam, finance en het management) Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Engels en hebt een basis Frans. Hoogspanningskabels, H2-backbones, CO2-leidingen en warmtenetten: dat zijn de projecten waar jij mee het verschil wil maken. We zijn op zoek naar een collega die van aanpakken weet. Een communicatief vaardige problemsolver, met een sterk planningsvermogen en een proactieve ingesteldheid. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij jouw talenten kan inzetten om impact te hebben op onze leefomgeving, vandaag en overmorgen, en geven jou het stuur in handen zodat je zelf bepaalt in welke richting je verder wil groeien! Waarom Arcadis? We kunnen onze doelen alleen bereiken als iedereen in staat is om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een op vaardigheden gebaseerde aanpak, waarbij je jouw unieke ervaring en expertise kunt inzetten om jouw carrièrepad uit te stippelen en de impact die we samen kunnen maken te maximaliseren. Je doet zinvol werk en, ongeacht je functie, help je mee aan het realiseren van duurzame oplossingen voor een welvarendere planeet. Druk jouw stempel; op jouw carrière, jouw collega’s, jouw klanten, jouw leven en de wereld om je heen. Samen kunnen we een blijvende erfenis creëren. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Onze inzet voor gelijkheid, diversiteit, inclusie en verbondenheid We willen dat je elke dag het beste van jezelf kunt laten zien op het werk. Daarom nemen we gelijkheid en inclusie serieus en dragen we verantwoordelijkheid voor onze daden. Het is onze ambitie om een voorkeurswerkgever te zijn en een geweldige werkplek te bieden aan al onze mensen.

review_candidates.title: Contrat Post-Doctoral - ANR ENCLAV
review_candidates.description: L’université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne associe le glorieux héritage du collège fondé par Robert de Sorbon au XIIIe siècle avec un projet pluridisciplinaire novateur. Première université française en sciences humaines et sociales (SHS), elle cultive depuis 1971 un esprit unique qui associe une approche scientifique exigeante et l’ambition de faire émerger de nouveaux savoirs qui transforment le monde. Implantée sur 26 sites franciliens, ouverte sur le monde et l'Europe avec les onze établissements qui composent l'alliance Una Europa, elle accompagne près de 45 000 étudiants par an et revendique l’un des plus grands réseaux d’alumni du continent. L’université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne est aujourd’hui la grande université française en sciences humaines et sociales, engagée pour replacer l’humain au cœur de l’approche scientifique, pour des sciences plus humaines ainsi que pour une société plus juste et durable. Cet engagement se traduit notamment par la mise en place depuis plusieurs années d’une démarche structurée et ambitieuse en matière de développement durable et de responsabilité sociétale (DD&RS). Le 23 août 2021, l’université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne a obtenu le label Human Resources Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) qui confirme son positionnement à l’échelle européenne et son engagement à appliquer les principes de la Charte européenne du chercheur et du Code de conduite pour le recrutement des chercheurs." , Centré sur l'Afrique de l'Ouest, le projet ANR ENCLAV (Environmental conflict narratives and policies: limate Change and Armed Violence in the Gulf of Guinea) analyse la production et la circulation de récits sur les conflits environnementaux ainsi que les politiques qu'ils légitiment : conseils pastoraux, comités fonciers ruraux, gestion communautaire des forêts, partage des bénéfices miniers. L'enquête va des arènes multilatérales et des bailleurs bilatéraux jusqu'aux administrations nationales et aux territoires ruraux, à partir d'une comparaison entre la Côte d'Ivoire et le Ghana. Le consortium réunit les laboratoires CESSP (Paris), SAGE (Strasbourg) et SOURCE (IRD), avec des chercheurs et chercheuses basé·es à Abidjan et à Accra. Le·la post-doctorant·e sera pleinement impliqué·e dans les tâches nationales et locales relatives à l'un des deux pays — Côte d'Ivoire ou Ghana, selon son ancrage empirique — tout en contribuant à la comparaison entre les deux et en participant à des missions dans le second pays. Localisation du poste : Paris et missions en Afrique de l'Ouest, Doctorat en science politique, anthropologie, sociologie, géographie ou études du développement, soutenu au moment de la prise de fonction, sur un objet lié à la sécurité environnementale, aux politiques foncières, à la gouvernance des ressources naturelles, à l'aide au développement ou aux conflits armés. Thèse reposant sur une méthodologie intensive de terrain. Spécialisation empirique sur la Côte d'Ivoire ou sur le Ghana, et disposition à enquêter dans les deux pays. Français et anglais courants, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Maîtrise des méthodes qualitatives (entretiens, focus groups, observation, archives et littérature grise) et goût du travail collectif dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire et multi-située. Connaissance des régions septentrionales de l'un ou l'autre pays. Expérience de l'enquête auprès d'institutions internationales, d'administrations ou d'organisations de l'aide. Familiarité avec l'écologie politique, l'économie politique agraire, la sociologie de l'aide ou l'analyse des politiques publiques en contexte africain. Pratique de la cartographie participative ou des SIG. Dossier de publications solide et internationalisé.

new_matches.description: ispace is seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior GNC Systems Engineer to join the System Design Group under the Global Design division, responsible for the design and development of lunar landers and other transportation and/or communication/navigation platforms. The ideal candidate will have in-depth experience on GNC (AOCS) design, implementation, integration, V&V and operations, good technical knowledge of multiple spacecraft subsystems and experience in the system engineering disciplines for spacecraft design. This is a unique opportunity to join a truly fascinating project, the first stage of ispace’s plans to perform resource prospecting on the moon. In this position, you will be assigned to one or more of ispace's projects, and join a small, international team of engineers working towards the detailed design and qualification of our first missions. Candidates with demonstrated "hands-on" experience in some engineering domains and interdisciplinary experience are preferred. Teamwork is valued, and depending on the strengths of each member of the systems engineering team, the responsibilities listed below will be assigned accordingly. Key responsibilities Support the definition of a “product baseline”, creating standard requirements, system architecture, ICDs, design and analysis goals, test plans and operations concepts. Perform system level trade-offs, coordinating inputs from various disciplines within the team, to evaluate any proposed changes of the design baseline to satisfy the need of each individual mission. Take ownership of the technical budgets, such as mass, propellant budget, pointing/landing accuracy for spacecraft performance. Ensure internal interfaces between various spacecraft subsystems are maintained. Contribute to requirements management ensuring all requirements are closed-out at the planned project landmarks. Contribute to risk assessments during the spacecraft development and support the Project Manager in defining risk mitigation plans Support AIT/Flight&Test Operations Groups and subsystem leads in defining test plans and specifications which will successfully verify the spacecraft design. Coordinate efforts between relevant subsystems and Operations Team in defining a spacecraft operational concept. Contribute to the maintenance of our Model-Based Systems Engineering tools and the integration. Qualifications Bachelor or Masters degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering or equivalent 5+ years of experience in at least two of the following: design, implementation, integration, V&V or operations of GNC (AOCS) subsystem Experience with programming languages such as Matlab, Python, or equivalent Self-motivated and comfortable making key decisions within a fast-paced environment High sense of accountability and ownership Excellent presentation skills, both verbally and written. Enthusiastic attitude and team player Working level in English Preferred skills Experience with design, analysis or testing of at least one other subsystem: Structure, Thermal, Avionics, Propulsion, Communications, On-board software. Experience with requirement decomposition (mission all the way to unit level) Experience performing FMECA, reliability analysis, and/or hazard analysis Experience with system level testing such as hardware-in-the-loop testing Experience with spacecraft operations Working level Japanese We will prioritize candidates currently in Japan with valid working visa. For overseas candidates, please note that you choose to proceed, this role requires relocation to Japan upon acceptance of the position. Compensation will be provided in JPY and aligned with local market benchmarks in Japan, based on the role’s level, scope, and prevailing industry standards. new_matches.title: Senior Strategist, Digital Communications
new_matches.description: Description About the Organization Founded in 1979, the National Immigration Law Center (NILC) is a leading non-profit organization (501(c)(3)) in the U.S. exclusively dedicated to defending and advancing the rights and opportunities of low-income immigrants and their loved ones. NILC’s mission is grounded in the belief that everyone living in the U.S. regardless of race, gender/gender identity, immigration status, or economic status — should have equal access to justice, resources, and educational and economic opportunities that enable them to achieve their full human potential. Together, NILC and the affiliated NILC Immigrant Justice Fund (IJF), a 501(c)(4) organization, work to advocate more directly for immigrant justice including direct federal immigration policy reform. NILC is committed to advancing its mission — which intersects race, immigration status, and class — through racial, economic, and gender justice and equity orientation. About The Position The Senior Strategist, Digital Communications (Sr. Strategist) supports the development and execution of digital strategies for NILC and NILC’s sister 501(c)4 organization. The Sr. Strategist is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital content across NILC’s platforms with an emphasis on graphic design and video content production. The Sr. Strategist manages the social media content and publishing calendar, email content and calendar, and digital ads program, explores innovative ways to drive audience engagement and growth across digital platforms; and monitors the performance of digital efforts. The Sr. Strategist will create and post digital content to uplift the stories of NILC, its programs and campaigns, and the clients and communities NILC serves as a means of amplifying the organization’s crucial legal, research, organizing, and advocacy interests. This role is a member of the Bargaining Unit . The Sr. Strategist, Digital Communications will be responsible for providing leadership and driving success in the following key areas: Specific Position Responsibilities Content Production and Planning Produce visual content such as content such as social media graphics, infographics, videos, and design elements for digital platforms. Create, edit, and oversee NILC and IJF’s digital platforms and tactics, including websites, email programs, blogs and social media accounts, ensuring a consistent organizational voice. Develop and publish content and incorporate all digital outposts and tactics (e.g., influencer partnerships, social media, email program, and digital ads, etc.) daily, and maintain content calendars. Digital Strategies Identify high-impact opportunities to increase brand visibility of NILC and IJF’s advocacy, programmatic, and movement building work, and grow digital audiences. Identify and execute creative and culturally relevant distribution tactics to innovate how we use social media and other digital accounts, promote our content, and engage with our audiences. Cultivate relationships with partners and social media influencers to amplify engagement with NILC and IJF’s social media and other digital content, developing & executing free and paid campaigns. Manage and develop strategy and content for advocacy components of NILC and IJF’s supporter email list engagement. Collaboration Support the Director, Digital Communication and other Strategic Communications leaders in the development of NILC and IJF short- and long-term digital strategies that advance NILC and NILC IJF’s programs and goals and implement those strategies in NILC and IJF’s day-to-day digital communications work. Collaborate with other members of the Strategic Communications team and cross-functional teams to craft and implement creative, multi-faceted digital strategies to support ongoing programmatic work, advocacy, public education, and live events, as well as media, development, and marketing campaigns. May be a part of a larger cross functional project using the MOCHA framework/methodology Act as a mentor to other Communications staff, including editing work, providing guidance, and other support as needed. ? Provide social media and other digital coverage in off-hour/non-peak rotation and for advocacy, development events, rallies, and other functions. Community Building and Analytics Monitor trends and emerging practices in social media, email advocacy, and other digital platforms, evaluating and recommending new platforms for NILC and IJF’s presence. Establish digital media metrics goals, objectives, and measures of success) to track, analyze, and regularly report on NILC and IJF’s digital media performance for NILC and IJF’s leadership teams. Supervisory Responsibilities May oversee outside consultants or vendors as needed. Shared Organization Responsibilities Champions NILC & IJF’s mission of advancing the rights of immigrants with low income by demonstrating a commitment to human rights, and racial, economic, and social justice Attends and actively participates in NILC meetings at the organization, department, project, and individual level Develops relationships and supports NILC and IJF colleagues across all teams, recognizing that each individual brings a unique background and perspective to the work and assuming good intent from each other. Follows through on commitments acting with a clear sense of ownership individually and collectively by taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures, establishing clear responsibilities and processes for monitoring work and measuring results, and designing feedback loops into work. Learns quickly when facing new situations by experimenting to find fresh solutions, taking on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks, and extracting lessons learned from failures and mistakes. Acts with integrity by following through on commitments, being direct and truthful, keeping confidence, and showing consistency between words and actions. Commits to centering NILC’s values of racial justice & equity, valuing diversity, fostering partnerships & collaboration, encouraging respect & personal well-being, and striving for transparency, integrity, and honesty in all decisions and actions In recognition of the fluidity of the work and ecosystem that NILC operates in, other duties may be assigned depending on organizational need. What We’re Looking For In This Role Commitment to NILC & IJF’s mission of advancing the rights of immigrants with low income and a demonstrated commitment to human rights, racial, economic, and social justice, and equity, diversity, inclusion, and justice for all. Collaborative, proactive, and action oriented working style with a strong service mentality promoting mutual accountability and inspiriting trust and confidence from colleagues, other NILC team members, and NILC leaders alike. Demonstrates sound judgement in decision-making, high integrity, and utmost respect for confidentiality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills: ability to read, analyze, and interpret as well as draft documents such as reports, correspondence, and presentations for various audiences. Self-starter with a strong strategic ability to move daily tasks forward in alignment with NILC’s broader organizational needs and goals Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail. Excellent time management skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple projects. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Communications, Marketing, or related field, or equivalent work experience required 7-10+ years of digital communications and social media experience, experience including 4+ years developing and executing digital plans and 2+ years of email campaign experience Expertise in the principles of online organizing and digital best practices including metrics/analytics Familiarity with multiple CRM and CMS systems and digital applications Familiarity with list/database management and growth Experience writing about social justice issues and how to leverage digital/social assets in campaigns Experience with website management (Drupal, WordPress) and leading website redesign projects Political and/or policy experience required Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Communications, Marketing, or another relevant field Experience in a nonprofit or social justice organization, particularly immigration-focused, preferred Experience in online media production, especially video and graphics preferred Proficiency in non-English languages spoken by Latinx, Asian, Pacific Islander, African, Caribbean, and Arab communities preferred. Repeating motions, like typing or answering a phone, that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.

Every new site we open starts with someone finding it, qualifying it, contracting it, and getting it ready to receive hardware. That person is you. This is a focused, commercially and technically intensive role. You will spend significant time reviewing inbound site proposals and opportunities, conducting due diligence on colocation providers, and driving procurement processes to close. Review incoming site proposals and colocation opportunities assessing power infrastructure, cooling systems, fibre connectivity, redundancy architecture, rack density, and physical security. Negotiate, structure, and manage commercial agreements, colocation leases, partnerships, and vendor contracts on behalf of the Company. Represent the Company in dealings with local authorities, regulatory bodies, utilities, and third-party stakeholders as required. Own the tendering and procurement process for new German capacity: RFI/RFP preparation, vendor shortlisting, commercial negotiation, and contract execution. Manage project budgets, financial models, and investment cases related to German expansion activities. Ensure all expansion activities comply with applicable German laws, regulations, and Company policies. Coordinate internal and external workstreams (Construction, DC Operations, Hardware, Procurement, Legal) to deliver expansion projects on time and within budget. Provide regular reporting to senior management on project status, risks, and material developments. Build and maintain a live pipeline of evaluated and pre-qualified German sites so Verda is never reacting to capacity needs reactively. Support the establishment and ongoing governance of the Company's operational presence in Germany. What We Are Looking For 5+ years in data centre capacity acquisition, colocation procurement, or infrastructure real estate with hands-on German market experience. Strong technical foundation: ability to assess a facility's power and cooling infrastructure, identify gaps, and know what questions to ask when something does not add up. Direct experience reviewing and evaluating inbound colocation proposals and shortlisting processes. Proven track record running RFI/RFP processes, commercial evaluation, and supplier negotiation. Comfortable reviewing and negotiating colocation and power contracts without needing Legal to explain every clause. Willingness and ability to travel frequently to sites across Germany. Strong Plus Experience evaluating high-density GPU or HPC facilities — understanding of 140kW+ per rack power requirements, liquid cooling readiness, and InfiniBand-compatible infrastructure. Existing relationships with major German colocation operators and capacity brokers. new_matches.title: Project Manager Linear Assets
new_matches.description: Arcadis is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van duurzame ontwerp-, engineering- en adviesoplossingen voor natuurlijke en gebouwde omgevingen. Met meer dan 34.000 medewerkers in ruim 30 landen zetten wij ons in om de levenskwaliteit te verbeteren. Iedereen speelt daarbij een belangrijke rol. Dankzij de kracht van vele nieuwsgierige geesten kunnen we samen de meest complexe uitdagingen ter wereld oplossen en samen meer impact maken. Welke uitdaging ga jij aan? Wij zoeken enthousiaste collega's om ons huidig energietransitie team te versterken bij de uitdagingen en opportuniteiten rond elektrificatie en transport van hernieuwbare energie. Je zal deel uitmaken van een ervaren team van projectmanagers, lead engineers en designers die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het uitwerken van hoogspanningskabel projecten, alsook later in onze groeidomeinen leiding- en warmteprojecten in het kader van energietransitie. Als projectmanager / lead engineer lineaire energie-infrastructuur werk je zelfstandig en efficiënt projecten uit en coördineer je daarbij het projectteam. Concreet betekent dit dat je de behoeften van de klant weet te vertalen in ontwerpen: je geeft input bij offertes, je kan de scope van het project bepalen en richting geven aan de technische oplossing tijdens de ontwerpfase. Je bepaalt de planning, draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor de verschillende onderdelen reikend van tracé over vergunning tot ontwerp. Je rapporteert periodiek over de gerealiseerde mijlpalen en de fundamentele problemen, je onderhoudt contacten met de opdrachtgever en je stuurt intern het projectteam aan. Je zorgt ervoor dat het project gerealiseerd wordt binnen het budget en de vooropgestelde timing en bent verantwoordelijkheid voor de deliverables, kwaliteit, het financiële aspect, rapportering en technische communicatie. Type projecten bij Arcadis waaraan je kan meewerken : “Hoogspanningsverbinding ALEGrO” "Antwerpen ontwikkelt warmtenet op grote schaal." Wat heb jij in je mars? Als projectmanager ben je vertrouwd met het werken binnen lump sum-projecten en het beheren van scope variations, en beschik je over een grondige kennis en ervaring in de opvolging van financiële KPI’s Je beschikt over sterke people skills om het huidige projectteam naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je bent ingenieur met minstens 7 jaar ervaring als projectmanager alsook lead engineer binnen ondergrondse infrastructuurprojecten. Je beschikt over een grondige kennis van ondergrondse infrastructuur (KLIP/KLIM, sleuven en gestuurde boringen) en bent gemotiveerd om deze expertise in te zetten voor de ontwikkeling van duurzame energie-infrastructuur in gans België. Je bent vertrouwd met vergunningen in België (omgevingsvergunningen in Vlaanderen en permis d’urbanisme / environnement in Wallonië) en weet hoe je deze procedures efficiënt toepast binnen infrastructuurprojecten. Je draagt kwaliteit en veiligheid hoog in het vaandel, kan vlot motiveren, delegeren en bijsturen. Dankzij je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden leg je vlot contact met zowel de klanten (de transmissienetbeheerders of industriële klanten) als de interne medewerkers (topografen, design- en engineeringsteam, finance en het management) Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Engels en hebt een basis Frans. Hoogspanningskabels, H2-backbones, CO2-leidingen en warmtenetten: dat zijn de projecten waar jij mee het verschil wil maken. We zijn op zoek naar een collega die van aanpakken weet. Een communicatief vaardige problemsolver, met een sterk planningsvermogen en een proactieve ingesteldheid. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij jouw talenten kan inzetten om impact te hebben op onze leefomgeving, vandaag en overmorgen, en geven jou het stuur in handen zodat je zelf bepaalt in welke richting je verder wil groeien! Waarom Arcadis? We kunnen onze doelen alleen bereiken als iedereen in staat is om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een op vaardigheden gebaseerde aanpak, waarbij je jouw unieke ervaring en expertise kunt inzetten om jouw carrièrepad uit te stippelen en de impact die we samen kunnen maken te maximaliseren. Je doet zinvol werk en, ongeacht je functie, help je mee aan het realiseren van duurzame oplossingen voor een welvarendere planeet. Druk jouw stempel; op jouw carrière, jouw collega’s, jouw klanten, jouw leven en de wereld om je heen. Samen kunnen we een blijvende erfenis creëren. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Onze inzet voor gelijkheid, diversiteit, inclusie en verbondenheid We willen dat je elke dag het beste van jezelf kunt laten zien op het werk. Daarom nemen we gelijkheid en inclusie serieus en dragen we verantwoordelijkheid voor onze daden. Het is onze ambitie om een voorkeurswerkgever te zijn en een geweldige werkplek te bieden aan al onze mensen.

Review and approve engineering designs to ensure compliance with project requirements, industry best practices, and applicable design standards. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and designers within the Bridges & Tunnels team. Contribute to design innovation, value engineering, and constructability reviews. Ensure all designs comply with local authority requirements and international codes and standards. Project Delivery Lead technical delivery of projects from feasibility and concept design through detailed design and construction support. Coordinate effectively with highways, drainage, geotechnical, utilities, traffic, and multidisciplinary project teams. Manage technical risks, programme requirements, and project deliverables. Support Project Managers in delivering projects on schedule and within budget. Participate in design reviews, workshops, and client presentations. Client & Stakeholder Engagement Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, and approval authorities. Act as a key technical point of contact for clients throughout project delivery. Liaise with local authorities including RTA, Dubai Municipality, and other relevant agencies. Support authority approvals and technical compliance submissions. Team Development Mentor and develop graduate, junior, and mid-level engineers. Promote a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Participate in recruitment, technical training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Business Development Support technical proposals, expressions of interest, and tender submissions. Contribute to identifying opportunities with existing and new clients. Assist in strengthening WSP's Bridges & Tunnels presence across the UAE and wider Middle East. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering. Minimum 12 years' experience in bridge and tunnel design within a consulting engineering environment. Proven experience leading the design of major transportation infrastructure projects. Strong technical expertise in: Highway bridges Flyovers and interchanges Viaducts Underpasses Tunnel structures Retaining structures Reinforced and prestressed concrete structures Steel bridge structures Experience using industry-standard structural analysis and design software. Working knowledge of AASHTO, Eurocodes, British Standards, and relevant local authority requirements. Significant UAE experience is preferred. Experience working on projects requiring RTA review and approval is highly desirable. Candidates with current or previous RTA Approval as a Bridges Engineer will be given preference. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Effective project planning and organisational abilities. Commercial awareness and client-focused approach. Commitment to quality, safety, and technical excellence. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today.

new_matches.description: Who We Are International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. The Need For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. Nine out of nine times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people living in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Communications Manager, Global Marketing & Communications to lead marketing communications and live event messaging for IJM’s major and principal donor initiatives. This role serves as a communications lead for in-person events, marketing campaigns, and recruitment journeys. Working across major and principal donor fundraising and marketing teams, the Communications Manager develops integrated messaging strategies and creates compelling content for digital, print, event, and donor-facing communications. The role also supports event scripting, donor communications, and multichannel marketing initiatives while maintaining messaging frameworks and reusable content assets that strengthen brand consistency across IJM’s global functions. This position is hybrid (onsite Tuesdays & Thursdays) if located in the Washington, DC area or remote for non-local candidates. It reports to the Global Director, Marketing Communications and is only available for candidates with the right to work in the US. Responsibilities: Write messaging strategies and content for major donor events, campaign initiatives, executive scripting, donor communications, and organizational storytelling moments; Shape stage narratives, speaker messaging, presentations, and donor communications for major donor engagement events; Develop and operationalize global marketing communications strategies aligned to IJM’s Brand Platform for major donor events, campaigns, and executive engagement opportunities; Lead content strategies that strengthen brand coherence and drive measurable audience reach, trust, and engagement; Coordinate messaging across digital, print, presentation, stage, and donor-facing channels to create cohesive audience experiences; Develop and maintain scalable messaging frameworks, narrative guidance, and reusable content assets that support consistent communications globally; Provide strategic communication counsel, editorial leadership, and coaching to cross-functional teams and contributors; Lead working sessions that strengthen messaging concepts, audience relevance, and communication effectiveness; Foster adoption of brand standards, shared messaging frameworks, and source-of-truth content resources; Promote responsible use of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled writing tools, to improve communication effectiveness and efficiency; and Participation in IJM’s community of spiritual formation. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, English, Nonprofit Management, or a related field; 8-10 years of experience in marketing communications, campaign communications, donor communications, or related fields; Demonstrated experience developing messaging strategies, narrative frameworks, editorial guidance, and reusable content assets for multi-channel communications; Strong background writing and editing high-visibility communications across live events, digital platforms, print materials, and donor engagement channels; Experience translating complex organizational priorities into clear, audience-centered messaging that inspires engagement, trust, and action; Proven ability to develop communications strategies and coordinate integrated marketing communications initiatives; Strong understanding of major and principal donor communications, fundraising messaging, and audience engagement principles; Demonstrated excellence in writing, editing, storytelling, and strategic communications; Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without direct supervisory authority; and Writing portfolio encouraged upon application. Cri tical Qualities: Eager commitment to IJM's Core Values: Christian, Professional and Bridge-Building; Global and cultural awareness, with sensitivity to communicating across diverse audiences and contexts; Strong interpersonal skills and self-awareness; Exceptional verbal and written communication; Flexible, collaborative and eager to support others; Effective team player who fosters collaborative environment; and Adept at creative problem solving. Application Process: Upload Resume, Cover Letter & Statement of Faith* in one PDF document . What is a statement of faith? L'enquête va des arènes multilatérales et des bailleurs bilatéraux jusqu'aux administrations nationales et aux territoires ruraux, à partir d'une comparaison entre la Côte d'Ivoire et le Ghana. Français et anglais courants, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Connaissance des régions septentrionales de l'un ou l'autre pays. Expérience de l'enquête auprès d'institutions internationales, d'administrations ou d'organisations de l'aide. Familiarité avec l'écologie politique, l'économie politique agraire, la sociologie de l'aide ou l'analyse des politiques publiques en contexte africain. Pratique de la cartographie participative ou des SIG. Dossier de publications solide et internationalisé.

new_matches.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About The Role If you’re passionate about pushing the limits of reliability, fault-tolerance, and operational excellence in complex distributed systems, Camunda offers the perfect stage. As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, you’ll take ownership of automated reliability testing and chaos engineering at the core of Camunda 8. This role thrives on curiosity, experimentation, and relentless improvement—you’ll break things (on purpose!) in safe environments to strengthen our platform before customers ever feel the impact. Here, you’ll make a measurable impact and guide product direction, all while learning new technologies and collaborating with talented, friendly colleagues who live our FAITH values (Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent, and Humor). Every day at Camunda, you’ll help us build robust systems, empower teams, and deliver a great user experience—even in failure scenarios. Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing Design, implement, and execute automated chaos experiments and reliability tests, validating Camunda's platform under real-world scenarios You will investigate, root-cause and debug potential failures or performance regressions of our Java based products Continuously improve existing load testing, chaos engineering and observability infrastructure to keep our system reliable and performant Here we use different languages, tools and frameworks like java, go, kubernetes, prometheus, grafana, etc. As an example of the above you can check out this CamundaCon recording or this blog post Introduce new tooling and approaches for reliability testing, driving measurable improvements to operational experience and user outcomes (examples from the past: introducing zbchaos as fault injection tool) Collaborate closely with QA and engineering (including cross-functional teams), sharing learnings (e.g. with our team blog) and influencing team roadmaps based on experiment findings Champion a pragmatic, autonomous approach to software design, solving tough problems and learning new principles and technologies (Kubernetes, Helm, Grafana, Java, Go, and more) Advocate for user-centric reliability by using and understanding Camunda’s products firsthand Defining Success For This Role Based on all of the above, you have end to end delivered a concrete task, as for example (the concrete goal will be defined during your onboarding): After 3 months, you have designed and delivered a way to run quick and reproducible load tests, allowing us: to reduce the feedback loops for engineers directly fitting into the development lifecycle Enable engineers to make use of it and extend it After 3 months, you have designed and implemented a realistic, automated, holistic load testing framework for Optimize, in close collaboration with Senior Engineers and Field teams: Conducted a deep-dive analysis of performance limits. Shared results with the relevant core engineering teams and enabled them to re-run the tests. Documented findings in public-facing documentation to help users better understand performance characteristics and guide their installation design. What You Bring Ability and/or willingness to use our product 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering (Java) Proven drive to experiment, learn new tech, and conduct automated reliability and chaos testing in distributed environments Deep enthusiasm for improving performance and fault-tolerance in production systems Autonomous, pragmatic problem-solving skills with an ability to guide and influence others Willingness and ability to use Camunda products and approach reliability from a user’s perspective Nice To Haves Hands-on experience with Go or other languages, in a multi-language context Working as SRE on distributed systems, with a strong software engineering mindset before Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm Charts, Operators, and related production infrastructure Experience running apps in production, with solid skills in monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance analysis Background in chaos engineering, automated reliability, load, or performance testing This role is an existing vacancy #C1 Compensation What We Have to Offer: We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Benefits & Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable. Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi. Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027. Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!
